svg.title: Model calls and reported tokens across the three pilot arms
svg.desc: A had 12 draft calls, no repairs, and 4803 reported tokens. B had 12 draft calls, 6 repair calls, and 8295 tokens. C had 12 draft calls, 6 repair calls, and 8291 tokens. B and C tied on exact answers. All 48 receipts had reported token usage; the server cache state was unmeasured. Result SHA-256 17c117821d347bf4ad248b70b319d8847bbedc2647edebf6b0a2e8edf996b10a; frozen dataset SHA-256 cef0921e2104650b4c7f1f5f0612379d35bbe393c6152811f9236543a8a20a40.
